approval_name: Form BRL Licence — Constructing and Working a Brewery for Manufacture of Beer
why_required: Statutory licence required under Rule 3(2) of the Maharashtra Manufacture of Beer and Wine Rules, 1966 to construct and operate a brewery manufacturing beer.
prerequisites: MPCB Consent to Establish (letter-of-intent stage); MPCB Consent to Operate (licence stage); Fire NOC (stage unspecified)
notes:
Core approval. Checklist page reconciles with an older 2014-reviewed page — see SRC-001 staleness flag.
Applies to any person/entity proposing to construct and work a standalone brewery for manufacture of beer in Maharashtra. Does NOT cover the separate BRL microbrewery (restaurant-based) licence — not modeled in this dataset.

why_required: Required under the Water and Air Acts for any industry/operation likely to discharge effluent or emit air pollution, before commencement of establishment works.
parallelizable: N/A — upstream in the chain relative to BRL-001
notes:
Exact MPCB category (and therefore exact fee/validity) not established by this research pass; depends on capital investment and pollution profile.
Applies before actual commencement of works establishing the brewery.

why_required: Required before commencement of production, including trial production, once the plant and required pollution-control systems are established.
prerequisites: MPCB Consent to Establish must be obtained first — explicitly evidenced (see dependencies.csv).
renewal: yes — renewal explicitly mentioned by source, exact period not established
notes: Applies once the brewery plant and required pollution-control systems have been established (i.e. after Consent to Establish).

approval_name: Provisional Fire Approval / Provisional No-Objection Certificate
why_required: Required for the proposed industrial building/activity's fire safety clearance prior to construction/operation.
parallelizable: yes — can proceed alongside MPCB/Excise document assembly
inspection_required: unknown — plausible but not explicitly confirmed by retrieved source
notes: Applies where fire approval or provisional NOC is required for the proposed industrial building or activity; competent authority (state directorate vs local fire dept) varies by site jurisdiction.

why_required: Required after construction or modification of the industrial building for final fire clearance.
prerequisites: Approved planning-authority drawings; compliance inspection against provisional NOC recommendations (if a provisional NOC was previously issued).
inspection_required: yes — explicit compliance/final inspection document required
notes: Applies after construction or modification of the industrial building where final fire clearance is required.

why_required: Required under the Factories Act, 1948 and Maharashtra Factories Rules, 1963 for a proposed factory plan.
notes:
High confidence on service existence, low confidence on document checklist.
Applies to a proposed factory plan; detailed document checklist was not retrieved in this research pass — treat the document list as incomplete.

approval_name: Factory Registration and Grant of Factory Licence
why_required: Required where the brewery qualifies as a factory under the Factories Act, 1948 and Maharashtra Factories Rules, 1963.
applicability_conditions: Applies if the brewery is classified as a MAH/hazardous or other factory — classification depends on facts (hazardous substances, quantities, storage) not yet available in the BusinessProfile. Treat as needs_information until those facts are collected.
prerequisites: Factory plan approval (DISH-PLAN-001) is suspected to precede this per standard Factories Act practice, but this sequencing was NOT explicitly confirmed by the retrieved source — see dependencies.csv (marked unknown, not depends_on).
renewal: unknown — factory licences are commonly renewed annually in practice, but this was not confirmed by the retrieved source

approval_name: FSSAI Food Business Licence or Registration
why_required: Beer manufacturing is treated as a food business activity under FSSAI's Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2018.
applicability_conditions: Applies to any food business operator manufacturing alcoholic beverages including beer. Exact licence level (central/state) and document checklist depend on production capacity/turnover/business structure not yet in the BusinessProfile — treat as needs_information until known.
parallelizable: yes — independent regulatory track from Excise/MPCB/Fire/DISH
renewal: yes — FSSAI licences are renewed periodically per standard practice; exact period not confirmed in this pass
notes: See also SRC-007 for the Alcoholic Beverages Regulations, 2018 reference.

approval_name: Registration as Manufacturer/Packer under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
why_required: Potentially required where beer is pre-packaged for retail sale and the business is the manufacturer/packer under Rule 27.
applicability_conditions: Applicability depends on whether beer is sold pre-packaged at retail and the specific packaging/distribution channel — bulk/institutional packaging may be treated differently. Treat as needs_information until the packaging model is known.

approval_name: Excise Label / Brand Registration for Beer
why_required: UNRESOLVED — the State Excise SCM portal exposes a label-registration system and a fee schedule for beer/wine brands, but the retrieved material does NOT establish this as a mandatory legal precondition for every Maharashtra brewery.
applicability_conditions: DO NOT mark as a mandatory required approval. Status: unknown/unconfirmed. Requires direct departmental confirmation before inclusion in a live applicant-facing roadmap.
notes: Exclude from the default applicant roadmap until confirmed. If shown at all, surface only as an informational note ('you may also want to check X with the department'), never as a required step.
